verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that candidate profiles exist and can hold attachments. Interview notes are mapped into scorecards inside Greenhouse with "no data silos", which suggests profile-centred records with feedback. Nothing documents a single unified record that brings together all the elements in the story. Missing for 10: evidence of a unified candidate profile view, resume parsing/storage on the profile, email thread capture, per-candidate activity history, consent/GDPR status on the record, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record

citations.quote: instantly maps AI-generated notes directly to scorecard questions for clear feedback
No extension, no third-party login, no data silos.
